benchmark_notes: The authors explicitly describe the selected Furan excited states as having highly dominant single-excitation character.
The specialized Furan script included in this bundle targets the four valence pi->pi* states with a CAS(6,5) proof-of-concept workflow.
instructions: Replace active_mos_1based with a chemically justified default active space.
Use state_overrides[STATE].active_mos_1based when a target needs a different space.
Check target_root using root_scan.csv; registry values are guesses.
Set sa_target_nroots when extra roots were included in the benchmark state average.
Rydberg states require diffuse functions and suitable diffuse active orbitals.
